Page 1205 
Myqorzo (aficamten) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-553400  
Guideline Name 
Myqorzo (aficamten)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
4/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Myqorzo  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming a diagnosis of obstructive 
hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM)  


=== PDF PAGE 1206 ===
Page 1206 
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient has New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class II or III symptoms (e.g., shortness 
of breath, chest pain)  
 
AND 
 
3 - Both of the following were measured prior to Myqorzo therapy:  
 
 3.1 Patient had a left ventricular ejection fraction of greater than or equal to 55%  
 
AND 
 
 3.2 Patient had a valsalva left ventricular outflow tract (LVOT) peak gradient greater than or 
equal to 50 mmHg at rest or with provocation  
 
AND 
 
4 - Trial and inadequate response, contraindication, or intolerance to one of the following at a 
maximally tolerated dose:  
• 
non-vasodilating beta blocker (e.g., bisoprolol, propranolol)  
• 
calcium channel blocker (e.g., verapamil, diltiazem)  
 
AND 
 
5 - Requested drug will not be used in combination with another cardiac myosin inhibitor (e.g., 
Camzyos)  
 
AND 
 
6 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a cardiologist  
 
Product Name:Myqorzo  


=== PDF PAGE 1207 ===
Page 1207 
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting positive clinical response 
to therapy (e.g., improved symptom relief)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Patient has a left ventricular ejection fraction of greater than or equal to 50%  
 
AND 
 
3 - Requested drug will not be used in combination with another cardiac myosin inhibitor (e.g., 
Camzyos)  
 
AND 
 
4 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a cardiologist  
 
2 .  Revision History  
 
Date  
Notes

New program
